label: Indonesia
short_description: Loyalty-program hotels in Indonesia, across Bali's resort coast, Jakarta's business districts and Surabaya in East Java.
intro: Indonesia's coverage in this directory spans three settings: Bali's beach and resort properties across the south of the island -- Nusa Dua's gated resort strip, Seminyak's beach-club scene, and inland stays near Ubud; Jakarta's business and diplomatic districts, from the Sudirman-Thamrin high-rise corridor to Mega Kuningan and the Central Jakarta shopping area; and Surabaya, the East Java capital, where hotels cluster in the central Tunjungan business district and the newer West Surabaya Pakuwon mall corridor.
